column1: # SHARED-KIT EXEMPTIONS -- append-only, and the current set is DERIVED.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the shared `party` kit in carry.tsv has no bearer, and
# tools/carry.py divides it among "everybody on the trip". The player decided
# (day 119) that TRISTLE carries none of it, so his own kit alone sets his
# movement and he can scout at a full 12". That is a standing arrangement, not a
# property of one trip, so it is a row here rather than a --bearers flag that has
# to be remembered every time. carry.py and party.py both read it whenever no
# One row per CHANGE. `action` is `exempt` or `resume`; the latest row for a name
# wins. Anyone with no row shares the kit as before.

column5: Player's standing instruction, day 119: "remove all of [the shared weight] from Tristle and get his movement rate up to 12 inches." The other nine can still carry the whole shared kit at heavy (9 inches) with 200 gp-wt spare, so the party rate is unchanged.

In a coma (1d6 = 6 turns, then a week's rest, DMG p.82) after the berserker took her to -8; her gear is in the common pool and the others carry it, at the player's word. RESUME when she is on her feet and has taken her kit back.
